Use case: ads-marketing. Create an original luxury technology campaign photograph for AI Receptionist. It must feel like elite aerospace industrial photography: immense visual authority, disciplined geometry, sophisticated restraint, precision-engineered materials, beautiful near-black tonal depth. Output ONE single scene, square 1:1, full bleed, highest available detail. Physical realism, beautiful coherent reflections, believable gravity and optics. A product campaign shot by a world-class industrial photographer on a large-format camera. Crisp resolved edges, carefully controlled white striplight, titanium grey, optical black and cool white. Rich middle tones so the subject remains visible, no muddy crushed blacks. No text or lettering whatsoever, no logos, no labels, no watermarks, no graphic layout, no montage, no contact sheet. No robots, faces, glowing orbs, neon purple/blue, holograms, sparkles, particles, ornamental rings, toy renders, cute miniature forms or rendered website mockups. No SpaceX branding, rockets, recognizable source composition or spacecraft.
Subject and framing: one ordinary premium matte graphite smartphone standing upright directly on a long seamless graphite architectural ledge, no separate plinth or puck. Three-quarter low camera view, the phone dominates 70% of the square height. Phone has credible thin titanium edges, understated softly rounded rectangular corners, black optically flat front glass and realistic subtle screen bezel. Screen is uniformly dark; exact software UI will be composited later. A narrow white ceiling strip is reflected elegantly at an edge of its front glass, never a luminous portal. Background is a colossal dark industrial cleanroom with only one horizontal seam dissolving into deep charcoal; no visible machinery or busy details. Strong silver rim light resolves the phone and restrained satin highlights reveal the shelf. A bold diagonal cast shadow and abundant quiet upper left space. Moody and sleek but clearly readable. Real macro material texture, no impossible transparent device. The photograph should feel like a premium launch campaign for a precise instrument, understated and expensive.
